name: quote-flow-react-node
description: A full stack quote pipeline workspace built with React, TypeScript, Node and Express.
author: Mohamed Ajmal - A curious developer working with real time projects

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @quoteflow/api" "npm run dev --workspace @quoteflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @quoteflow/api && npm run build --workspace @quoteflow/web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
